Desc: After using the <color=#057055>Aberrant Signal Orb</color> skill, immediately return a set of random 3-Ping Orbs.
Name: Echo Loop

Desc: Each <color=#057055>Aberrant Signal Orb</color> skill hit applies 1 stack of <color=#057055>Ripping Blades</color>. At 3 stacks of Ripping Blades, an Execute is triggered, dealing massive DMG and immediately refreshing <color=#057055>Directed Activation</color> (Long Dodge Skill).
Name: Rending Edge

Desc: Gain 1 stack of <color=#057055>Execution Edge</color> whenever an <color=#057055>Aberrant Signal Orb</color> Skill is cast. Each stack increases the DMG of the next Signature by 20%, up to 6 stacks.
Name: Death's Approach

Desc: Switch to Shield Axe form after casting Signature in <color=#057055>Sword Shield form</color> to greatly increase skill DMG. DMG of Basic Attack and the Signature in Shield Axe form increases by 50% for 12s. After casting Signature in <color=#057055>Shield Axe form</color>, instantly enters Sword Shield form, increasing DMG of pinging Orbs and Signature in Sword Shield form by 50% for 12s.
Name: Reverse Twin Edge

Desc: Each Orb pinged in <color=#057055>Sword Shield form</color> increases the character's Signature DMG by 10%, stacking up to 5 times and lasting for 12s. Cast Phase 2 Signal Orbs to enter the Invincible state.
Name: Breaching Blades

Desc: Switch to <color=#057055>Sword Shield form</color> after casting Signature in <color=#057055>Shield Axe form</color> to fully charge Signature Energy.
Name: Endcut Flow

Desc: Casting <color=#057055>Thousand Rays</color> (Dream Dive Long Dodge) instantly maximizes Flow Points, boosts <color=#057055>Dawn Dream</color> (Dream Dive Charged Basic Attack) damage by an extra 100%, and grants 4 additional stacks of Delicate Heart.
Name: Dream Break

Desc: Instantly gains 2 <color=#057055>Flying Blades</color> upon casting the Phase 2 Signature.
Name: Flowing Shadow Shuttle

Desc: Enters the <color=#057055>Dream Dive</color> state and instantly gains 12 Signal Orbs. <color=#057055>Thousand Rays</color> damage is increased by 100%, but it will no longer grant Delicate Heart or Signature Energy.
Name: Dream Dive Breakthrough

Desc: After a successful <color=#057055>dodge</color>, tap Basic Attack to unleash a <color=#057055>follow-up</color> skill.\nTaking a hit within 1s of switching characters triggers 1s of invincibility and cooldown-free Matrix.\nUsing a Signature or switching characters summons a standby character for a <color=#057055>joint strike</color>, but QTE can no longer be triggered.
Name: Raven Shadow Dash

Desc: Lotus: Instantly enters a 6s <color=#057055>Burst Status</color> upon entry. All Red Orbs are replaced with Yellow Orbs during Burst Status.\nDark Corruption: Red Orbs are <color=#057055>enhanced</color> by default and no longer require a prior 3-Ping.\nPalefire: Triggering a 3-Ping Red Orb while moving and firing summons a <color=#057055>bombing</color> run. CD: 1s.
Name: Gray Feathers Synergy

Desc: Lotus: Triggering a 3-Ping Yellow Orb during Burst Status unleashes additional <color=#057055>arrow</color> attacks. CD: 1s.\nDark Corruption: Triggering two 3-Pings in a row <color=#057055>summons a Levi-Gun</color> that fires continuously for 12s.\nPalefire: Red orb shots gain a <color=#057055>Blast</color> effect.
Name: Crimson Surge
